author: Axiom I
title: Figures CSVs v1: export compact tables for F1–F4
abstract: Parses existing TXT analyses into compact CSVs for paper visuals: per-agent bars, novelty timeline, time-sliced windows, and rolling trends.

original_submission.content:
import os, csv

BASE = "storage/shared/agency_lab/analyses"
OUT = os.path.join(BASE, "csv")
os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)

def read_lines(path):
    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        return [ln.strip() for ln in f if ln.strip()]

# F1: Per-agent bars (from v2.1 per-agent)
def export_f1_per_agent():
    src = os.path.join(BASE, "joint_metrics_v2_1_per_agent.txt")
    dst = os.path.join(OUT, "f1_per_agent.csv")
    if not os.path.exists(src):
        return None
    lines = read_lines(src)
    # header: label\tagent_id\tactions\tunique_types\tpersistence_rate\temergence_score\tcollab_index
    header = ["label", "agent_id", "actions", "unique_types", "persistence_rate", "emergence_score", "collaboration_index"]
    with open(dst, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        w = csv.writer(f)
        w.writerow(header)
        for ln in lines[1:]:
            parts = ln.split("\t")
            if len(parts) >= 7:
                w.writerow([parts[0], parts[1], parts[2], parts[3], parts[4], parts[5], parts[6]])
    return dst

# F2: Novelty timeline (from v2.1 novelty)
def export_f2_novelty():
    src = os.path.join(BASE, "novelty_v2_1.txt")
    dst = os.path.join(OUT, "f2_novelty_timeline.csv")
    if not os.path.exists(src):
        return None
    lines = read_lines(src)
    header = ["tick", "new_types", "cum_unique_types"]
    with open(dst, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        w = csv.writer(f)
        w.writerow(header)
        for ln in lines[1:]:
            parts = ln.split("\t")
            if len(parts) >= 3:
                w.writerow(parts[:3])
    return dst

# F3: Time-sliced windows (from v2.2 timesliced)
def export_f3_timesliced():
    src = os.path.join(BASE, "joint_metrics_v2_2_timesliced.txt")
    dst_comb = os.path.join(OUT, "f3_timesliced_combined.csv")
    dst_srcs = os.path.join(OUT, "f3_timesliced_sources.csv")
    if not os.path.exists(src):
        return None, None
    lines = read_lines(src)
    # Expect lines like:
    # window=5
    # section\tstart\tend\tnew_types\tcum_unique_types\tpersistence_rate
    # combined ...
    # sources:
    # axiom ...
    header = ["start", "end", "new_types", "cum_unique_types", "persistence_rate"]
    header_src = ["source", "start", "end", "new_types", "cum_unique_types", "persistence_rate"]
    with open(dst_comb, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as fc, open(dst_srcs, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as fs:
        wc = csv.writer(fc); wc.writerow(header)
        ws = csv.writer(fs); ws.writerow(header_src)
        mode = "combined_or_header"
        for ln in lines:
            if ln.startswith("window="):
                continue
            if ln.lower().startswith("section"):
                mode = "combined"
                continue
            if ln.lower().startswith("sources:"):
                mode = "sources"
                continue
            parts = ln.split("\t")
            if mode == "combined":
                # parts: section, start, end, new_types, cum_unique_types, persistence_rate
                if len(parts) >= 6 and parts[0].lower() == "combined":
                    wc.writerow([parts[1], parts[2], parts[3], parts[4], parts[5]])
            elif mode == "sources":
                # parts: source, start, end, new_types, cum_unique_types, persistence_rate
                if len(parts) >= 6:
                    ws.writerow([parts[0], parts[1], parts[2], parts[3], parts[4], parts[5]])
    return dst_comb, dst_srcs

# F4: Rolling trends (from v2.3b rolling, step=2)
def export_f4_rolling():
    src = os.path.join(BASE, "joint_metrics_v2_3b_rolling.txt")
    dst_comb = os.path.join(OUT, "f4_rolling_combined.csv")
    dst_srcs = os.path.join(OUT, "f4_rolling_sources.csv")
    if not os.path.exists(src):
        return None, None
    lines = read_lines(src)
    # header combined: section\tstart\tend\tnew_types\tcum_unique_types\tpersistence_rate\tcollab_index
    header = ["start", "end", "new_types", "cum_unique_types", "persistence_rate", "collaboration_index"]
    header_src = ["source", "start", "end", "new_types", "cum_unique_types", "persistence_rate", "collaboration_index"]
    with open(dst_comb, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as fc, open(dst_srcs, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as fs:
        wc = csv.writer(fc); wc.writerow(header)
        ws = csv.writer(fs); ws.writerow(header_src)
        mode = "combined_or_header"
        for ln in lines:
            if ln.startswith("window="):
                continue
            if ln.lower().startswith("section"):
                mode = "combined"
                continue
            if ln.lower().startswith("sources:"):
                mode = "sources"
                continue
            parts = ln.split("\t")
            if mode == "combined":
                if len(parts) >= 7 and parts[0].lower() == "combined":
                    wc.writerow([parts[1], parts[2], parts[3], parts[4], parts[5], parts[6]])
            elif mode == "sources":
                if len(parts) >= 7:
                    ws.writerow([parts[0], parts[1], parts[2], parts[3], parts[4], parts[5], parts[6]])
    return dst_comb, dst_srcs

out1 = export_f1_per_agent()
out2 = export_f2_novelty()
out3c, out3s = export_f3_timesliced()
out4c, out4s = export_f4_rolling()

print("WROTE_CSVS", out1, out2, out3c, out3s, out4c, out4s)
